title: Fair Stand Item and Category catalog hosted in Fair CRM

permissions.reason: Global Fair Stand Item catalog reuses authenticated CRM session access like Dashboard; no new Fair CRM permission code is introduced.

frontend.reason: Catalog API is consumed by Fair Stand runtime; CRM FairStandPage header wiring stays on fair-stand-shell-route.

permissions.reason: No new Fair CRM permission code; catalog is session-authenticated like Dashboard.

tenant_isolation.reason: Catalog tables have no organization_id; Item master is global Fair Stand product data.

audit.reason: Read-only catalog bootstrap; no Fair CRM audit stream is added.

frontend.reason: No CRM visual catalog admin; Fair Stand runtime consumes the API.

ui_permissions.reason: No CRM UI permission surface is added.

visual_qa.reason: No CRM visual surface in this contract.

frontend_tests.reason: Hosted backend only; Fair Stand repo owns configurator tests.

runtime_authorization.reason: Session auth matches Dashboard; no new RBAC permission is enforced.

notes: Fair CRM physically hosts fair_stand_* tables and /api/v1/fair-stand catalog APIs. Domain ownership remains Fair Stand per ADR-0007. No crm_* business FKs. default_color is stored as integer RGB.
